cities.name: Prague
cities.local_food_tip: Try Czech classics like dumplings, potato soups, trdelník pastries and comforting sweet-baked dishes — warm, hearty and perfect for a full sightseeing day.
cities.full_day:
Morning: 🏰 Prague Castle District: Walk through grand courtyards, castle walls and stunning viewpoints over red rooftops. → ⛪ St. Vitus Cathedral: Step into a Gothic masterpiece full of color and height. → 🧱 Golden Lane: Tiny medieval houses creating a fairytale feeling. → ☕ Coffee in Malá Strana: Quiet cobblestone corners and cozy cafés.

Afternoon: 🌉 Charles Bridge: Walk across historic statues and panoramic riverside views. → 🕰️ Old Town Square: Medieval towers, lively streets and classic Prague vibes. → ✨ Astronomical Clock: Catch the famous hourly show. → 🍽️ Lunch: Dumplings, soups, pastries or veggie-friendly Czech comfort food.

Sunset: 🌅 Letná Park or Vltava Promenade: Picture-perfect golden reflections over the river.

Night: 🌃 Old Town Evening Walk: Soft lights, calm streets and dessert stops near the river.

ideas: 🌸 Petřín Hill blossoms and peaceful gardens.
☕ Outdoor cafés across Old Town squares.
🌉 Riverside paths glowing in soft spring light.
🍦 Ice cream stops near Charles Bridge.
🌳 Shady Letná Park with perfect view terraces.
🍁 Castle-hill foliage turning orange and gold.
🏛️ Ideal museum days (National Gallery, Jewish Museum).
🎄 Old Town Square’s famous Christmas village.
✨ Wenceslas Square festive booths and lights.

public_transport_tips: 🚇 Metro is the fastest way between major attractions.
🚋 Trams offer scenic routes through Old Town and riverside streets.
🚶 Many historic areas are best explored on foot.
📱 Use ‘PID Lítačka’ app for tickets and live schedules.

city_events.description: 🎶 Free open-air music festival on the Vltava river islands.

city_events.description: ✨ City-wide light installations and digital art projections.

city_events.name: Old Town Christmas Market
city_events.description: 🎄 One of Europe’s most iconic holiday markets.

cities.name: Brno
cities.local_food_tip: Taste Moravian comfort meals like soups, dumplings, pastries and warm baked dishes — simple, satisfying and perfect for strolling.
cities.full_day:
Morning: 🏰 Špilberk Castle: Hilltop fortress with city panoramas and calm walking paths. → 🌿 Špilberk Park: Tree-lined paths ideal for a slow morning. → ⛪ Cathedral of St. Peter and Paul: Iconic Gothic towers above the Old Town. → ☕ Coffee in Denis Gardens with soft sunlight.

Afternoon: 🏙️ Old Town Streets: Colorful façades, lively squares and small corners to explore. → 🧩 Brno Astronomical Clock: Curious modern landmark on Náměstí Svobody. → 🍽️ Lunch: Moravian soups, dumplings, pastries or veggie-friendly meals.

Sunset: 🌅 Petrov Hill or Špilberk Terraces: Golden light falling over rooftops.

Night: 🌃 Moravian Square or Old Town Walk: Student-friendly cafés, dessert spots and chill evening atmosphere.

ideas: ☀️ Outdoor cafés reopening in Old Town.
🌊 Lužánky Park fountains and shady lanes.
🏛️ Museum days (Moravian Museum, Brno City Museum).

public_transport_tips: 🚋 Trams connect all major districts quickly.
🚶 Castle area is best explored on foot.
🚌 Buses extend to parks and elevated viewpoints.

city_events.name: Brno Spring Fair
city_events.description: 🌼 Regional crafts, flower shows and outdoor activities.

city_events.name: Ignis Brunensis
city_events.description: 🎆 International fireworks festival over the lake.

city_events.name: Brno Music Marathon
city_events.description: 🎶 Several days of concerts all over the city.

city_events.name: Christmas in Brno
city_events.description: 🎄 Multiple markets and cozy festive squares.

cities.name: Český Krumlov
cities.local_food_tip: Try Bohemian dumplings, sweet pastries, warm soups and simple vegetarian-friendly plates — gentle flavors perfect for exploring a fairytale town.
cities.full_day:
Morning: 🏰 Krumlov Castle: Explore grand courtyards and the iconic tower overlooking the river bend. → 🌉 Castle Tower: Panoramic red-rooftop views. → 🏛️ Old Town Walk: Colorful façades, stone bridges and craft shops. → ☕ Coffee by the Vltava.

Afternoon: 🎨 Egon Schiele Art Center: Atmospheric modern exhibitions. → 🌊 Riverside Paths: Peaceful walks with great photo spots. → 🍽️ Lunch: Dumplings, potato soups, pastries or vegetarian meals.

Sunset: 🌅 Castle Gardens: Magical golden light over rooftops.

Night: 🌃 Lantern-Lit Old Town: Calm cobblestone streets and river reflections.

ideas: ☀️ Riverside cafés opening for outdoor seating.
📸 Old Town colors in soft spring light.
🍦 Ice cream stands across Old Town.
🏛️ Ideal season for art and museum visits.
🎄 Festive stalls in Old Town Square.
✨ Winter lights around the castle area.

public_transport_tips: 🚶 The entire town is walkable — no need for public transport.
🚌 Regional buses connect Krumlov with nearby cities.

city_events.name: Krumlov Art Spring
city_events.description: 🎨 Exhibitions, creative workshops and local art shows.

city_events.name: Five-Petalled Rose Festival
city_events.description: 🏰 Medieval costumes, shows and historic street celebrations.

city_events.name: Autumn Festival of Arts
city_events.description: 🎭 Music, performances and cultural evenings.

city_events.name: Christmas in Krumlov
city_events.description: 🎄 Warm decorations and charming small-town winter vibes.

cities.name: Ostrava
cities.local_food_tip: Try Silesian & Moravian comfort meals like potato dishes, dumplings, warm soups and pastries — cozy and filling, perfect for long walks.
cities.full_day:
Morning: 🏭 Dolní Vítkovice: Explore huge steel structures, towers and futuristic walkways. → 👀 Bolt Tower: Glass observation deck with full 360° views. → ☕ Industrial-style café break.

Afternoon: 🏙️ Masaryk Square: Colorful central buildings and fountains. → 🌳 Komenského Sady: Large riverside park perfect for cooling off. → 🍽️ Lunch: Moravian soups, dumplings, pastries or vegetarian bowls.

Sunset: 🌅 Bolt Tower or Castle Hill: Golden light over industrial silhouettes.

Night: 🌃 Stodolní Street (quiet zones): Dessert cafés and creative corners.

ideas: 🏭 Industrial photos in soft spring light.
🍦 Ice cream spots in the city center.
📸 Dramatic steel silhouettes in fall colors.
✨ Winter lights around the industrial area.

public_transport_tips: 🚋 Trams easily connect Dolní Vítkovice and city center.
🚌 Buses reach distant parks and viewpoints.
📱 Use ‘IDOS’ or ‘DPO App’ for real-time schedules.

city_events.description: 🎨 Modern art exhibitions and creative workshops.

city_events.name: Colours of Ostrava
city_events.description: 🎶 One of Europe’s most unique music festivals held in an industrial area.

city_events.name: Industrial Autumn
city_events.description: 🏭 Exhibitions, photography walks and cultural events.

city_events.name: Ostrava Christmas
city_events.description: 🎄 Festive markets and winter decorations around the center.

cities.name: Olomouc
cities.local_food_tip: Try Moravian soups, dumplings, pastries and warm vegetarian dishes — soft flavors great for a calm historical walk.
cities.full_day:
Morning: 🏛️ Upper Square: Elegant façades, fountains and a peaceful historical atmosphere. → 🗿 Holy Trinity Column: Massive baroque UNESCO monument. → ⛪ St. Wenceslas Cathedral: Gothic towers and serene interior. → ☕ Coffee in the university district.

Afternoon: 🌿 Smetana Park or Bezruč Gardens: Shaded paths and quiet riverside corners. → 🎨 Olomouc Museum of Art: Classic and modern exhibitions. → 🍽️ Lunch: Moravian soups, dumplings, pastries or vegetarian meals.

Sunset: 🌅 Cathedral Hill: Soft golden views over rooftops and gardens.

Night: 🌃 Old Town Lights: Calm evening walk among fountains and pastel façades.

ideas: 🎨 Museum visits to cool off indoors.
✨ Town Hall winter stalls and lights.

public_transport_tips: 🚋 Trams are the easiest way to move through the city center.
🚶 Most historic landmarks are within walking distance.
🚌 Buses reach parks and outer districts.
